tiers.definition: All eligible objects participating in at least one frozen-protocol significant collision pair, including excessive ground embedding.
Exclude synthetic native_pedestrian_surface embedding pairs; retain all other frozen-protocol significant pairs.
Starting from the no-ground tier, additionally exclude pairs whose two endpoint semantics are both Tree.
Starting from the no-ground tier, retain only significant pairs for which neither endpoint semantic is Tree, Vegetation, or Bonsai.

aggregation.metric: 100 * unique eligible objects implicated by retained pairs / eligible objects in the run
